text:
sam: quick heads-up 1: i ran into a collision-ish case where two different quant builds produced the same bench fingerprint. sketching a small proposal for making fingerprints both stable and collision-resistant.

sam: problem: current fingerprint = sha256(model.tar.gz) + quant_label. but build metadata (build-id, docker tag) can drift and cause identical sha across different runtime flags, or conversely small metadata diffs still matter.

darya: yikes. collisions hurt dedupe and can hide regressions. we need canonicalization: strip non-deterministic files (build logs, timestamps) before hashing, and include a runtime-salt field.

noah: +1. also: use a fast secure hash (blake3) for fingerprinting to keep compute low in intake path. keep sha256 as fallback for older tooling.

maria: proposal: fingerprint = blake3(canonical_artifact) . concat(':'). concat(serialize(sorted(quant_params))) . concat(':'). concat(runtime_salt)

maria: runtime_salt idea: short tag representing runtime flags that affect execution (e.g., cuda_driver_version, torch_build, mmapped_kv). default salt = environment digest if customer doesn't provide.

raj: question: how do we get canonical_artifact deterministically? we can't force every team to produce a canonical tar. ingest adapter should attempt a canonicalize step: strip /build/, zero out timestamps, sort file listing. if adapter can't canonicalize, mark fingerprint as "best-effort" and add `fingerprint_confidence: low`.

sam: agreed. and if confidence is low, bypass dedupe (treat as distinct) to avoid missing regressions. we should log a warning and surface in the intake UX.

noah: also suggest collision detection heuristics: if a benchmark result shows a large delta but fingerprint_confidence=low, auto-trigger a re-run with forced-canonicalize mode.

ingest-bot: note: bench-runner v2 supports `canonicalize=true` flag and will emit `artifact_canonicalized=true|false` in telemetry.

maria: separate but related: golden_quota enforcement. we need a cheap server-side enforcement path so customers with every-rollout golden mode don't bankrupt themselves. sketch: quota config + lightweight sampler in intake.

maria: quota pseudo-config:
```json
{
  "golden_mode": "every-rollout | sampling-percent | on-demand",
  "golden_quota_per_day": 10,
  "golden_seq_limit": 128,
  "golden_batch_limit": 1
}
```

raj: operationally, if golden_mode=every-rollout and quota exhausted, intake should downgrade to sampling-percent until quota resets, and notify the org owner. do not silently skip golden checks.

noah: add a cost-estimate field to bench_job so intake can pre-check: `estimated_cost_usd`. if estimated_cost > quota_remaining * avg_cost, ask for manual override.

darya: we should also allow an org-level grace policy (e.g., allow 2 extra golden runs per week) for active rollouts. track grace uses auditable.

sam: about validation gates: acceptance should be two-stage: first raw numeric checks (latency P95, tokens/sec, mem), then semantic checks (golden artifacts/regression tests). if numeric passes and semantic fails, fail rollout and create an auto-bisect ticket.

maria: decision calls from this thread:
- fingerprint: adopt blake3 canonical artifact + sorted quant params + runtime_salt; mark `fingerprint_confidence` high/low. low-confidence = bypass dedupe.
- canonicalize: intake adapter will attempt deterministic canonicalize step; bench-runner can opt-in with `canonicalize=true`.
- collision handling: large delta + low confidence -> forced re-run; large delta + high confidence -> fail and block rollout.
- golden_quota: enforce per-org daily quota; intake downgrades to sampling or stalls with notification when quota exhausted. allow configurable seq_len/batch caps for golden runs.
- cost pre-check: bench_job must include `estimated_cost_usd`, intake will refuse or require override if exceeds budget.

maria: next actions: i'll update the intake RFC with the fingerprint algorithm and quota config. noah/raj can pair on the canonicalize util and unit tests. sam/darya will draft the UX warning copy. i'll ping @eng-ml when RFC is live.

raj: will start a small PoC for blake3 canonicalize util.

noah: will add estimated_cost_usd to bench schema and wire a preflight check.

maria: thanks all. :sparkles:
